appName.message: Tabdial – Visual Speed Dial for New Tab
appName.description: Store and browser name, max 75 characters. Keep the brand Tabdial.

appDesc.message: A speed dial for your new tab: your sites in groups and folders, backed up daily. Nothing sponsored, no account, no subscription.

actionTitle.description: Tooltip of the toolbar button that adds the current page, and the heading over the groups in its popup.

tabTitle.description: Browser tab title of the new tab page. Use the browser's own name for a new tab.

groups.description: Screen reader name of the group tabs at the top.

newGroup.description: Button and dialog title for creating a group of dials.

speedDials.description: Screen reader name of the grid of sites.

defaultGroup.description: Name of the first group, made on install.

importedGroup.description: Name for an imported group that had no name.

welcomeTitle.message: Your favorite sites, one click away
welcomeTitle.description: Heading on the empty new tab page right after install.

welcomeText.message: Start with the sites you visit most, add your own, or bring your dials over from another speed dial.

emptyGroupText.message: Add your favorite sites to it, or drag dials onto its tab from another group.

addYourMostVisited.description: Main button on the empty page.

addSite.description: Button and empty tile that open the dialog for adding a dial.

importFromOther.description: Link on the empty page that opens the import settings.

addDial.description: Dialog title. A dial is one site tile on the page.

edit.description: Tooltip of the pencil button on a dial.

editNamed.description: Screen reader name of the pencil button. $1 = the dial's title.

address.description: Field label: the web address of a dial.

title.description: Field label: the name shown under a dial.

pasteImageLink.description: Placeholder of the image address field, under the Upload image button.

group.description: Field label: which group the dial is in.

folder.description: Name of a new folder; also the label of the folder field when editing a dial and the screen reader name of an open folder.

folderName.description: Screen reader label of the name at the top of an open folder, which can be changed there.

noFolder.description: Choice in the folder field: the dial is in no folder.

newFolder.description: Choice in the folder field: a new folder is made for the dial.

confirmDeleteGroup.description: $1 = group name, $2 = a count like "5 dials" (nDials).

confirmDeleteEmptyGroup.description: Asked before deleting a group with no dials. $1 = group name.

invalidUrl.message: Enter a web address, like example.com.
invalidUrl.description: Shown at the address field. Keep example.com.

alreadyIn.description: Shown at the address field when the group already has that site. $1 = group name.

imageUnreadable.message: That image could not be read.

nDials_one.description: Count of dials when the language's plural rule says 'one'. $1 = the number.

nDials_other.description: Count of dials for every other number. $1 = the number.

ratePrompt.message: Enjoying Tabdial? A rating helps others find it.

searchPlaceholder.message: Search your sites or the web
searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the search box on the new tab page: it finds the user's saved sites, or searches the web with the browser's default search engine.

searchNoMatch.message: No site matches. Press Enter to search the web.
searchNoMatch.description: Shown in the grid when no saved site matches what was typed in the search box.

syncLabel.message: Keep the same dials on my other computers

syncHint.message: Uses your browser's own sync, so it works where you're signed in to the same browser with sync on. Addresses, titles and groups sync; thumbnails and settings stay on each computer.

syncTooLong.message: Your dial list is too long to sync, so it is not being synced.

syncUnreadable.message: The synced dial list is not in a format Tabdial understands.

syncCodeHint.message: A browser's own sync stops at that browser: Chrome's never reaches Firefox. A sync code keeps the same dials in all your browsers. Your list is stored on nexuscortex.dev, encrypted with the code, so we can't read it. Free, no account.

syncCodeNew.description: Button in Settings: start syncing between browsers; it makes a sync code.

syncCodeHave.message: Already have a sync code from another browser? Enter it here.

syncCodeUse.description: Button next to the field where a sync code from another browser is entered.

syncCodeOnHint.message: Your dials sync between browsers with this code. In another browser, open Tabdial's Settings, go to Sync and enter it, or open the link there. Anyone who has the code can see and change your dials, and we can't get it back for you: keep a copy somewhere safe.
syncCodeOnHint.description: Settings and Sync are the names of the dialog and its tab.

syncCopied.message: Copied. Keep it to yourself: anyone who has it can see and change your dials.
syncCopied.description: After copying the sync code or the link that holds it.

syncStopAll.description: Button: stop syncing between browsers in every browser and delete the list from nexuscortex.dev.

confirmSyncStopAll.message: Stop syncing between browsers everywhere? The list on nexuscortex.dev is deleted, and your other browsers stop the next time they open a new tab. Each browser keeps its dials.

syncStopped.message: Stopped. This browser keeps its dials.

syncCodeOn.message: This browser now syncs with your sync code.

syncCodeInvalid.message: That isn't a sync code. A sync code has 25 letters and digits, like XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX.

syncCodeUnknown.message: No dial list is synced with this code. Check it against the browser it came from.

confirmSyncCode.message: Sync this browser with the sync code in this link? The dials synced with it are added to yours, and everyone who has the code sees yours too. Go on only if the code is your own.
confirmSyncCode.description: Shown in Settings, above the button that uses the code, when a link with a sync code was opened in this browser.

jump.description: Settings heading for the feature that opens a site from the address bar: type z, a space and a few words. Called 跳转 in Chinese.

jumpHint.message: Type z and a space in the address bar, then a few words of a site's address or title, and press Enter to go straight there.
jumpHint.description: Shown in Settings and once as a tip on the new tab page. Keep "z" as is: it is the keyword.

jumpHistory.description: Checkbox in Settings, and the last suggestion in the address bar until it is on.

jumpHistoryHint.message: Tabdial reads it only on this computer; it is never sent anywhere.

jumpHistoryAgain.message: “$1” was on when this was saved. The browser asks for it on each computer, so switch it on again in Settings.
jumpHistoryAgain.description: After importing a Tabdial file or restoring from Google Drive, on its own line. $1 = jumpHistory.

jumpSearch.description: Address bar suggestion when no site matches. $1 = the words typed.

jumpType.message: Type a few words of a site's address or title
jumpType.description: Address bar suggestion before anything is typed.

backupsHint.message: Before your first change each day, Tabdial keeps a copy of your dials on this computer.

backupsKept.message: The last $1 are kept; copies older than the newest $2 keep your dials but not their thumbnails.

noCopies.message: No copies yet. The first one is made the next time you change something.

beforeRestore.description: Label of the backup copy made just before a restore.

dialsInGroups.description: What a backup copy holds. $1 = nDials, $2 = nGroups, e.g. "12 dials in 3 groups".

restoreCopy.description: Screen reader name of a Restore button. $1 = a date like "Fri, Oct 2".

restoreBefore.message: Restore the dials you had before your last restore
restoreBefore.description: Screen reader name of a Restore button.

confirmRestoreCopy.message: Replace your dials with the copy from $1? Your current dials are kept, so you can undo this here.

confirmRestoreBefore.message: Replace your dials with the ones you had before your last restore? Your current dials are kept, so you can undo this here.

restoredBefore.message: Restored the dials you had before your last restore.

copyGone.message: That copy is no longer available.

unlockPitch.message: Sort a group's dials into your other groups, and create teams to share groups with your colleagues.
unlockPitch.description: Bold first sentence of the paid unlock offer.

unlockTerms.message: One-time $$9, no subscription. Not happy? Email us within 30 days for a full refund.
unlockTerms.description: Follows unlockPitch. The price is in US dollars in every language: keep $$9 exactly (it shows as $9).

alreadyPaidHint.message: Your other computers with Chrome sync on unlock by themselves. Anywhere else, sign in with the Google account you back up to.

licenseHint.message: Or enter the license key shown after payment:

unlock.description: Button next to the license key field.

paymentServiceError.message: The payment service answered $1. Please try again later.

driveIntro.message: Once a day, everything (thumbnails and settings too) goes to one file in your Google Drive. Tabdial can only see the files it creates there.

driveFound.message: Your Drive already has a Tabdial backup from $1. Restore it to bring its dials and thumbnails here, or back up now to replace it with this computer's.

driveFailed.message: Backing up to $1. The last backup failed: $2

driveDailyLast.message: Backing up to $1 every day. Last backup: $2.
driveDailyLast.description: $1 = Google account email, $2 = date and time.

accountNotPaid.message: This Google account hasn't unlocked Tabdial yet. On the computer where you paid, connect Google Drive with this account once, or enter the license key shown after payment.

confirmDriveRestore.message: Add the dials and thumbnails from your Google Drive backup that are missing here, and use its background and layout?

confirmDriveDisconnect.message: Stop backing up to Google Drive? The backup file stays in your Drive.

noDriveBackup.message: There is no Tabdial backup in your Google Drive yet.

driveSignInAgain.message: Google needs you to sign in again.

driveAnswered.message: Google Drive answered $1. Please try again later.

googleUnreachable.message: Couldn't reach Google ($1). Tabdial will try again.

yourDataHint.message: Export a file to keep your own copy, thumbnails included, or to move to another browser.

importFormatsHint.message: Import accepts Tabdial files and export files from Speed Dial 2, Group Speed Dial, speed-dial.net and Yet Another Speed Dial, plus Toby's JSON export and Infinity New Tab's backup file.
importFormatsHint.description: Keep the product names as they are.

guides.description: Followed by links named Speed Dial 2, FVD Speed Dial, Group Speed Dial and speed-dial.net.

fvdPaste.message: Moving from FVD Speed Dial? Paste its export text

nothingToImport.message: Nothing new to import: those dials are already here.

importUnknown.message: This file is not a format Tabdial can read.

importEncrypted.message: This Group Speed Dial backup is encrypted. Turn off encryption in Group Speed Dial, export again, then import.

mostVisitedAlreadyHere.message: Your most visited sites are already here.

mostVisitedFailed.message: Couldn't add your most visited sites: $1

howToUse.description: Link in Settings to the guide on the website.

webBase.description: Where this language's pages are on the website (guides). Only the language part changes: https://nexuscortex.dev/tabdial/<lang>/.

sortGroup.description: Button next to the group tabs: suggests a better group for each dial of the group on screen.

sortAbout.message: Tabdial can suggest a better group for the $1 in "$2". To do that, it sends their site names (like example.com) and titles, and the names of your other groups with a few of their site names, to nexuscortex.dev, which asks TypeSafe, an AI service in the US. We don't keep any of it. Nothing moves until you confirm.
sortAbout.description: $1 = nDials, $2 = group name. Shown before anything is sent: it is the user's consent, so keep every part.

sortLocked.message: Sort suggests a better group for each dial in "$1" and moves only the ones you confirm. It comes with the paid unlock.
sortLocked.description: $1 = group name. Shown to a free user who clicks Sort, followed by unlockTerms.

sortReview.message: These dials seem to fit another group better. Uncheck any you want to leave here.

sortApply.description: Button that moves the checked dials.

sortNothing.message: No suggestions: none of these dials clearly fits one of your other groups better.

sortFailed.message: Sorting didn't work this time. Check your connection and try again in a minute.

teamUnreachable.message: Couldn't reach nexuscortex.dev. Check your connection and try again.

teamServiceError.message: nexuscortex.dev answered $1. Please try again in a minute.

teamLinkInvalid.message: That isn't a Tabdial invite link. It starts with https://nexuscortex.dev/tabdial/join/#

teamLinkGone.message: This invite link no longer works. Ask an admin of the team for the new one.

teamNotMember.message: You're no longer in this team.

teamNotAdmin.message: Only the team's admins can do this.

teamFrozen.message: This team is frozen: the unlock it was created with was refunded, so no one can change its team groups. Buying the unlock again in the browser that created the team unfreezes it.
teamFrozen.description: Members still see the team groups as they last were.

teamLastAdmin.message: A team needs an admin. Make someone else an admin first, or delete the team.

teamNeedsUnlock.message: Creating a team comes with the unlock. Joining one is free.

teamConflict.message: Another admin just changed $1. This is their version now; make your change again.

teams.description: Settings section. A team = people who all see the same team groups.

teamsHint.message: Give your team the same dials. Team groups show on everyone's new tab page next to their own groups, and only the team's admins can change them. Joining is free and needs no account. Team groups are stored on nexuscortex.dev encrypted with a key that only your team's invite link carries, so we can't read them. A team dial's thumbnail is shared too: every member sees the picture an admin sets, a screenshot of a page included.

inviteLink.description: The link an admin shares to let people join a team.

createTeamHint.message: You'll be its first admin. Then share its invite link in your team's chat.

yourNameHint.message: The team's admins see you by this name.

teamCreated.message: $1 is ready, with a first team group. Share the invite link below with your team.

teamAdmin.description: Role in a team, after the team name: 'Acme · admin'.

teamMember.description: Role in a team, after the team name: 'Acme · member'.

dailyCopies.description: Button: the team's copies of the last 30 days.

confirmLeaveTeam.message: Leave $1? Its team groups leave your new tab page. Sites you copied into your own groups stay.

confirmDeleteTeam.message: Delete $1 for everyone? Its team groups disappear from every member's new tab page, and this can't be undone.

inviteLinkCopied.message: Invite link copied. Share it only with your team: anyone who has it can join and see the team groups.

replaceLink.description: Button: make a new invite link; the old one stops working.

confirmReplaceLink.message: Replace the invite link? The old one stops working. People already in the team are unaffected.

linkReplaced.message: The invite link was replaced. Share the new one to invite people.

you.description: Marks the user's own entry in the list of members.

removeMember.description: Button: remove someone from the team.

confirmRemoveMember.message: Remove $1 from the team? The invite link is replaced too, so they can't come back with the old one.

memberRemoved.message: $1 was removed, and the invite link was replaced: share the new one with your team.

teamCopiesHint.message: The team groups as they were before each day's first change, for 30 days. Going back to one changes them for everyone.

noTeamCopies.message: No copies yet: the first change of each day keeps one.

confirmRestoreTeamCopy.message: Put the team groups of $2 back as they were on $1, for everyone?

teamCopyRestored.message: The team groups are back as they were on $1. Members get them the next time they open a new tab.

joinHint.message: You'll see its team groups next to your own groups. Only its admins can change them. Joining is free and needs no account.

joinedTeam.message: You joined $1. Its team groups are after your own groups.

teamMark.description: Tooltip on the tab of a team group. $1 = team name.

teamGroupMember.message: A team group of $1. Only its admins can change it; copy a site to your own groups with its copy button.

teamGroupAdmin.message: A team group of $1. What you change here reaches everyone in the team when they open a new tab. It can take up to 5 minutes.

teamGroupEmpty.message: No sites in this team group yet.

copyToMyGroup.description: Button on a dial of a team group, and the title of its dialog.

confirmDeleteTeamGroup.message: Delete the team group "$1" for everyone in $2?

moveLeft.description: Group tab menu: move the group one place to the left.

copyToTeam.description: Group tab menu: make a team group with this group's dials. $1 = team name.

groupFor.description: New group dialog: whose group it is (only me, or a team).
